Estimate the slope of the trend line for the scatter plot above. Round your answer to the nearest $0.5.$
question.worked_solution:
First, let's draw an approximate trend line for our scatter plot:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14224903/assets/b79dacf04634d91eae5ee8dd82a6603ed93357d6300a95e6343a683429caf506.png)

It seems that the trend line passes through $({x}_{1},{y}_{1})≈(4,6)$ and $({x}_{2},{y}_{2})≈(8,4).$

Therefore, we estimate the slope $m$ of the line as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}m & ≈\frac{{y}_{2}-{y}_{1}}{{x}_{2}-{x}_{1}} \\  & =\frac{4-6}{8-4} \\  & =\frac{-2}{4} \\  & =-0.5\end{aligned}
$$
